dict.string: Cosmodex mirrors your scheduled items into a dedicated “Cosmodex” calendar so you can view them in Apple Calendar.
Cosmodex creates and updates events in its own “Cosmodex” calendar to mirror your dashboard schedule.
Cosmodex mirrors your tasks into a dedicated “Cosmodex” list in Apple Reminders so you can see them on your phone.
Cosmodex creates and updates reminders in its own “Cosmodex” list to mirror your tasks (name, due date, subtasks).
